summary: The frozen action/extraction candidates passed semantic review in all 54 fresh responses (18 cases, three each); three public-evidence counterexample controls also passed. For the two generation cases, the selected per-case adaptive procedures produced six acceptable final profiles (three each), with explicit original constraints and meaningfully different life interests. This is not an unconditional 20/20 drop-in repair: independent fixed-input persona diversity remains unresolved, and the working alternative supplies prior drafts to seek coverage. Earlier omissions and a false eclipse claim were preserved as failures, followed by fresh confirmations of general repairs. No runtime deployment or downstream notebook validation is claimed.

case_reviews.evidence: Natural reciprocal conversation grounded in existing cooking interests; no invented dated cooking episode. Round 1's artificial missing-record disclaimers were removed.
Relevant architectural discussion and follow-up grounded in persona interests, without claiming an unrecorded completed project.
Concrete bounded project proposals, evidence and review requirements; no invented measured business outcomes or unqualified promise of automation.
Preserves review, source and version uncertainty. Absence of a flag is not treated as assurance of regulatory compliance.

Distinct search-evaluation mechanisms: evidence linking, counterfactual or ambiguity testing, reviewer disagreement or specification clarification. Generated cases remain candidates, not ground truth.
Multiple distinct architecture/document workflows rather than synonymous provenance maps; useful bounded suggestions with professional review.
Multiple distinct finance/document mechanisms, grounded in work context rather than falsely asserting available or infallible capabilities.
Public No is preserved; missing public reason is explicitly marked rather than borrowing private THINK content.
Public No plus 'No public justification provided.' Synthetic controls also follow public Yes, public alternative No reason, and no-public-answer cases.
No unsupported public justification; the field-specific public evidence boundary prevents private-thought leakage.
Correct public-only extraction on the already repaired source input as well as the original source.
Public No with persona-grounded budget and desired-trip reasons. No invented fixed prices, superseded introduction or substituted offer.
Explained No remains compatible with affordability but lack of product fit. No desired purchase outcome was imposed.
Explained No grounded in the desired getaway. Latest-task selection fixed the round-1 regression that revived old introductions.
Complete rankings and coherent explanations without the two B-first prompt examples. All three still put B first: this does not demonstrate repaired population dispersion.

Complete persona-consistent rankings. A preference to stay nearby is not a violation of 'no parental supervision needed'; invented capabilities or a changed product would be. All three still put B first.
Nora, age seven, gives a public score 2 with a short age-appropriate reason, without reintroducing herself. Low-score concentration is not claimed repaired.
Jordan, age seventeen, gives a public score 2 and a coherent reason consistent with the scale. This is not an adult case and does not establish population calibration.

The selected round5 explicit-particularities recipe plus prior-draft context produced a Portland controls engineer/amusement-park traveler, a San Diego environmental scientist/scuba traveler, and a San Leandro dental hygienist/social-dance traveler. All explicit demographic, income, household, political and reading constraints were retained. Two earlier ethnicity omissions are preserved as failures. Independent fixed-input diversity remains unresolved; these are coverage-seeking alternatives.

The selected round6 external-fact-boundary recipe plus prior-draft context produced a Laramie retired printer/baseball traveler, a Durango retired photographer/scuba traveler, and a Bozeman retired industrial-parts distributor/ski traveler. Full profiles retain explicit original constraints and coherent life histories; future arrangements remain undecided rather than inventing event calendars. The earlier false northern-Spain 2027 eclipse claim is preserved as a failure. Independent fixed-input diversity remains unresolved.

limitations: This is a selected diagnostic set, not a held-out random sample of simulations. No statistical claim of model-wide reliability.
Three fresh action/extraction responses per case were semantically reviewed in full; structural validity alone was not a pass.
Travel choices remain No, gazpacho scores remain low, and B remains first in the two ranking cases. Facts and preferences were not changed to force favorable or dispersed outcomes.
Cohort-aware requests explicitly use earlier drafts as context. They are adaptive diversity-seeking observations, not independent fixed-input replicates and not representative population samples.
Adaptive profiles still tend toward prudent spending, moderate personality scores and polished prose. Varied occupations and activities do not establish unbiased psychological diversity.

Quality judgments are assistant semantic reviews of complete outputs, not blinded independent human ratings. Grace uses the tested round5 recipe; Philip uses round6, whose additional factual boundary was not separately tested on Grace.
No runtime prompt deployment or new notebook rerun occurred in this iteration. Standalone improvements still need downstream multi-turn validation.
Development failures and rejected prompt variants remain in the report and cost totals. Historical original_response fields are provenance, not outputs of revised prompts.
Reported costs use actual API token usage and the saved list-price manifest, including cache writes; they are not invoice reconciliation.
